purpose: Teach: 小平/小樽/明石/近江/杉並/伏見/新庄/川越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、東京小平の研究機関と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — work with the research institute in Kodaira, Tokyo.
lines.style: Calm, direct authority. No preamble. Single measured breath before the name. Expects compliance without explanation. Confident pause after the task — waiting for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。北海道小樽の地域経済論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the regional economics papers from Otaru, Hokkaido.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, slight nod in the voice. No hesitation. Efficient confirmation of understood instruction. Quiet conviction — this is what he does.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、明石の海洋研究所と共同研究しろ
lines.en: Ren — collaborate on a joint research project with the marine research institute in Akashi.
lines.style: Same measured tempo as before. Slightly more weight on the task itself. No inflection change — same authority, different scope. Still waiting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。近江商人の経営史の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the papers on the business history of Omi merchants.
lines.style: Same swift affirmation. No variation — he's in the rhythm now. Taking each task seriously without theatrics. Slight upnod implied in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、東京杉並のキャンパスとも交流しろ
lines.en: Ren — exchange with the campus in Suginami, Tokyo as well.
lines.style: The 'as well' carries quiet accumulation — another assignment in the stack. Same authority, same breath. The word order implies breadth without apology.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。京都伏見の醸造文化の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the papers on brewing culture from Fushimi, Kyoto.
lines.style: Same rhythm. The assignments are stacking but his tone doesn't strain. Professional acceptance. No catch in the voice — he's capable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、山形県新庄市の民俗学研究を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the folklore research from Shinjo City, Yamagata Prefecture.
lines.style: Sharper than before. A command now, not collaboration. Slight tightening on 'read' — the task is direct. Still composed but the edge is clearer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。埼玉県川越の歴史的街並み研究を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the historical streetscape research from Kawagoe, Saitama Prefecture.
lines.style: Final affirmation. A beat longer this time — settling into the weight of everything assigned. Still compliant, but the very slight pause before the prefecture name suggests internal acknowledgment of the accumulation. Quiet close.
